summary: Regression frontend testing for Capacitor 7 native plugin integration (@capgo/capacitor-wifi 7.0.3 + @capacitor-community/bluetooth-le ^7). All critical scope items PASS. /staff/portal loads cleanly with no JS pageerrors and no Capacitor/Plugin related console errors. The lazy-loaded plugin imports + Capacitor.isNativePlatform() guard work correctly in browser (web fallback active).
critical_code_review_comments: useSmartSignals.js lazy import pattern is correct: isNative() guard prevents @capgo/capacitor-wifi & @capacitor-community/bluetooth-le from loading on web, avoiding any module init crashes. Capabilities object reports platform='web', nativeWifi=false, nativeBluetooth=false, webBluetooth=false in Playwright (no navigator.bluetooth) — exactly as expected.

Bluetooth scan button is disabled in browser when both nativeBluetooth and webBluetooth are false; click does not crash (verified force=true click). UI shows the amber 'Bluetooth in diesem Browser nicht verfügbar' hint, which is correct.

SSID override persistence works end-to-end: input -> save -> localStorage.staff_wifi_ssid_override = 'Termokos-Office' -> toast 'WLAN-Name gespeichert' -> 'Aktiv: Termokos-Office' pill. After full page reload, the value is auto-loaded into the input and the pill again displays, confirming the SSID_OVERRIDE_KEY read on hook init.

useGeofenceWatch.js already includes wifi_ssid + bluetooth_beacons in POST /api/staff/geofence/check-presence body (lines 39-46). Note: in Playwright the call did not fire during this test because navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition is not granted in headless; this is an environment limitation, not a regression. Logic is correct in code.
Chat overlay (Nachrichten) opens without crash when triggered from the staff portal.

No 'module not found' / no TypeError / no Capacitor warnings in the console after the new ESM imports were added — confirms the bundler resolves the optional native plugins via dynamic import() correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Capacitor 7 plugin integration is regression-clean on web. On native (iOS/Android) the lazy imports will resolve to real plugins — that path cannot be exercised in Playwright; manual native testing required if iOS/Android builds are produced. The 401/404 console resource errors observed (e.g. notifications, weather) are pre-existing and unrelated to this change.
